case: If you believe two healthy starters now are worth more than waiting on one star back, this trade is worth sending. The chart is missing this week, so this call rests on your gut and the sheet, not a chart value. Walker is the RB3 and the best player in the deal, and reports say his groin injury is short-term, so the risk is that you sell a top back just before he returns. His past seasons show him cooling off in the second half, while Higgins has tended to heat up late. Tuten gives you a back who can play right away during a bye week that hits your lineup. You will need to cut someone to make room, but the depth is the smarter push for a team chasing points now.

sides.reason: A top WR and a starting RB who can both play this week.
